title: Contrastive Discovery: Open-Ended Scientific Discovery over Competing Explanations
abstract: arXiv:2611.14514v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended, data-driven scientific discovery, yet most of them evaluate hypotheses pointwise, testing an empirical claim $h$ only against its complement $\neg h$. When evidence rejects $h$, the agent learns that one explanation is unlikely but not which alternative the evidence supports. To recover that alternative, we introduce Contrastive Discovery, which replaces the single hypothesis with a contrast set, a scientific question paired with mutually exclusive and collectively exhaustive competing explanations. Each experiment is scored by how its evidence redistributes belief across the set, and the question is resolved when belief concentrates on one explanation. Because contrast sets change only the unit an agent proposes and scores, an existing agent can use them to re-evaluate evidence it has already collected or to guide its search. translated_title: 对比发现：基于竞争性解释的开放式科学发现
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体正被越来越多地用于开放式、数据驱动的科学发现，然而大多数智能体以逐点方式评估假设，仅将经验性断言 $h$ 与其补集 $\neg h$ 进行对照检验。当证据否定了 $h$ 时，智能体只能得知某一解释不太可能成立，却无法得知证据究竟支持哪个替代解释。为了找回这一替代解释，我们提出了“对比发现”，它用对比集取代单一假设——对比集是一个科学问题与一组互斥且穷尽所有可能的竞争性解释的配对。每个实验根据其证据如何在集合内重新分配信念来进行评分，当信念集中于某一个解释时，该科学问题即被视为解决。由于对比集仅改变了智能体提出和评分的单位，现有智能体可以利用它们来重新评估已收集的证据，或引导其搜索。在六个领域中，89%的逐点候选……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“对比发现”框架，用互斥且穷尽的竞争性解释集合取代单一假设检验，通过证据对信念在集合内的重新分配来评估实验、确定被支持的替代解释，从而改进开放式科学发现。
en_tdlr: Contrastive Discovery replaces pointwise single-hypothesis testing with contrast sets of mutually exclusive, collectively exhaustive competing explanations, scoring each experiment by how its evidence redistributes belief across the set to resolve which alternative explanation the evidence supports.
